items.summary: A Bristol Myers Squibb executive called early data for its BioNTech-partnered PD-L1xVEGF-A bispecific antibody very promising, as the companies advance the program through trials.

items.headline: ESMO: Tango trims headcount after impressing analysts with ‘highly synergistic’ RevMed combo
items.summary: Tango Therapeutics is cutting staff after presenting phase 3 combination data with a Revolution Medicines drug that analysts described as highly synergistic.

items.headline: ESMO: Genmab posts phase 3 win for Elahere rival, ahead of ‘very interesting’ data from Merus buyout
items.summary: Genmab reported a phase 3 win for a therapy competing with Elahere, ahead of anticipated data from its pending acquisition of Merus.

items.headline: BMS sheds light on patient death in CAR-T trial, wants to get program back on track
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb disclosed details of a patient death in a CAR-T cell therapy trial and said it is working to resume the program.

items.headline: BioNTech sees ‘limited’ benefit to ADC after phase 3 reveals modest efficacy, ILD cases
items.summary: BioNTech said its antibody-drug conjugate showed only limited benefit in a phase 3 trial, with modest efficacy and cases of interstitial lung disease.

items.headline: Brazilian Markets Convulse After Unexpected Election Result
items.summary: Brazilian financial markets sold off sharply after an election result that investors had not anticipated.

items.headline: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing
items.summary: Anthropic warned of catastrophic risks from artificial intelligence as the company moves toward a widely anticipated share listing.

items.headline: Anthropic begins countdown to IPO with prospectus filing
items.summary: Anthropic has filed a prospectus with regulators, formally starting the countdown toward an initial public offering of its shares.

items.headline: Brazil’s markets tumble as investors bet Lula will add to fiscal pain
items.summary: Brazilian markets fell as investors judged that a Lula election win would add to the country's fiscal pressures.

items.headline: CISA promises proactive critical infrastructure defense in new strategic plan
Strike curbs output at Canada’s largest copper mine
items.summary: A strike is curbing production at Canada's largest copper mine, reducing near-term copper output from the country's top base-metal operation.

items.headline: India’s BPCL to Cut Russian Oil Imports Due to Higher Prices
items.summary: India's Bharat Petroleum plans to reduce purchases of Russian crude oil after price increases eroded the discount that had made the barrels attractive.
